title: Whitewashed cave home with a sunny courtyard near Lake Negratin
why_great: A sheltered dining patio, terracotta courtyard and sculpted white cave rooms give this Freila home its character. The listing describes a move-in-ready home with three bedrooms, one bathroom and a wood-burning stove. Advertised floor area is 50 m² with a 114 m² plot. Lake Negratin is nearby, but this is not a lakefront property. Cave rooms have limited direct daylight.
